snippet.title: Haunted Cleaner #TeaseYaGame
snippet.description:
Hi #TeaseYaGame!  
📪 Feel free to join our newsletter: headkino.com

What if tidying a room could free a trapped soul? 👻🧹

In Haunted Cleaner you sort, clean, and decorate the homes of the deceased, uncovering the stories left behind. Solve light puzzles and help spirits to move on. ✨
